The '''Republic Fleet Auxiliary Support Vessel''' was a support [[Starship/Legends|ship]] used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The most notable use of this vessel was when the spacecraft [[Redeemer (Republic Fleet Auxiliary Support Vessel)|''Redeemer'']] picked up [[Callista Ming]], [[Geith Eris]] and other members of [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis's]] heretical group of Jedi, after they decided to take up commands in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].
